description: ODC (context: offline producer). On the blank Mobile app (create-blank --kind Mobile), a public service action and a public global event triggered by a server action. The output of this job is the fixture tests/fixtures/odc/blank-mobile-producer.oml (apply with --base blank-mobile.oml --out blank-mobile-producer.oml).
